69701.meaning1: meditation attainment in which one lives; state of meditation in which one dwells
69701.commentary: (MNa) yāya vihārasamāpattiyā'ti yāya lokiyāya vihārasamāpattiyā, yāya lok'uttarāya vihārasamāpattiyā.

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho mayaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa evam'ārocimha, imāsañ'ca imāsañ'ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ mayaṃ lābhino'ti, yaṃ no āyasmā anuruddho bhagavato sammukhā yāva āsavānaṃ khayā pakāsetī'ti?

idh'āvuso moggallāna, bhikkhu cittaṃ vasaṃ vatteti, no ca bhikkhu cittassa vasena vattati. so yāya vihārasamāpattiyā ākaṅkhati pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ viharituṃ, tāya vihārasamāpattiyā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ viharati.

69703.meaning1: vicinity of a dwelling; area around a residence

examples.text: mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā vihāre vā vihārass'ūpacāre vā upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ vā maṇḍape vā rukkhamūle vā santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto n'eva uddhareyya na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

69704.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Maggasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

69705.meaning1: site of the dwelling; grounds of the residence
69705.commentary: (VINa) vihāro nāma yaṃkiñci pāsād'ādi-sen'āsanaṃ. vihāravatthu nāma tassa patiṭṭhān'okāso.

examples.text: tena vihārakārakena bhikkhunā vihāravatthuṃ sodhetvā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo
ñattidutiyena kammena vihāravatthuṃ na desāpetvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ. ekaṃ piṇḍaṃ anāgate, āpatti thull'accayassa. tasmiṃ piṇḍe āgate, āpatti saṅgh'ādisesassa.

69706.meaning1: inspecting the site of the monastery; looking at the dwelling site

examples.text: ahaṃ, bhante, mahallakaṃ vihāraṃ kattu'kāmo sassāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ. so'haṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ vihāravatthuolokanaṃ yācāmī'ti. dutiyam'pi yācitabbā.

69707.meaning1: appointing the site for the monastery

69709.meaning1: leading one's life; spending one's time; fashioning one's lifestyle

examples.text: tathā tathā, āvuso, bhikkhu vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yath'āssa vihāraṃ kappayato na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.

69710.meaning1: leads one's life; spends one's time; fashions one's lifestyle

examples.text: tathā tathā, āvuso, bhikkhu vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yath'āssa vihāraṃ kappayato na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.

69711.meaning1: (of a state of being) living in; staying in; remaining in; who is; who has
69711.meaning2: staying or sojourning, being in such and such a condition

examples.text: bhikkhu atthatakathino phāsuvihāriko cīvaraṃ ādāya pakkamati, amukaṃ nāma āvāsaṃ gamissāmi, tattha me phāsu bhavissati vasissāmi, no ce me phāsu bhavissati

69712.meaning1: living ardently; remaining persistent; making continuous effort

examples.text: evaṃ vihārim'ātāpiṃ, ahorattam'atanditaṃ. taṃ ve bhadd'ekaratto'ti, santo ācikkhate muni.

69713.meaning1: (of a state of being) living in; who has; being
69713.meaning2: staying or sojourning, being in such and such a condition
69713.commentary: (ANa) mama evaṃ vihārino'ti mayhaṃ evaṃ jigucchāvihārena viharantassa evaṃ jigucchanaṃ nappatirūpaṃ bhaveyya nānucchavikaṃ.

examples.text: tesaṃ sampannasīlānaṃ, appamādavihārinaṃ, samma'd'aññā vimuttānaṃ, māro maggaṃ na vindati.
yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī'ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi
kathaṃ vihārībahulo'dha bhikkhu, pañc'oghatiṇṇo atar'īdha chaṭṭhaṃ, kathaṃ jhāyiṃ bahulaṃ kāmasaññā, paribāhirā honti aladdha yo tan'ti.
evaṃvihārībahulo'dha bhikkhu, pañc'oghatiṇṇo atar'īdha chaṭṭhaṃ, evaṃ jhāyiṃ bahulaṃ kāmasaññā, paribāhirā honti aladdha yo tan'ti.

69715.meaning1: rather (this is) just the mode of living (of)

examples.text: ekaccā devatā evam'āhaṃsu, na kālaṅ'kato samaṇo gotamo, na'pi kālaṅ'karoti, arahaṃ samaṇo gotamo, vihārotv'eva so arahato evarūpo hotī'ti.
so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī vihāsiṃ.
tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
attanā coday'attānaṃ, paṭimaṃsetha attanā, so attagutto satimā, sukhaṃ bhikkhu vihāhisi.
attanā coday'attānaṃ, paṭimaṃsetha attanā, so attagutto satimā, sukhaṃ bhikkhu vihāhisi.

69719.synonym: abhisaṅkhata, upakkhaṭa, paññatta, paṭiyatta, parikappita, parikammakata, vinīta, sajjita

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ubhatomukhā putoḷi pūrā nānāvihitassa dhaññassa, seyyath'idaṃ sālīnaṃ vīhīnaṃ muggānaṃ māsānaṃ tilānaṃ taṇḍulānaṃ
so sace ākaṅkhati, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, eko'pi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhā'pi hutvā eko assaṃ, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ
anāpatti yo koci viññū dutiyo hoti, tiṭṭhati na nisīdati, araho'pekkho, aññavihito nisīdati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā, āmo'ti paṭijānanti. ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, kathaṃ vihitakaṃno pana tumhe āyasmanto issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā'ti? te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti, asampāyantā mamaññ'eva paṭipucchanti.
idha kho pana vo, cunda, sallekho karaṇīyo. pare vihiṃsakā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha avihiṃsakā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parinibbānāya, pāṇ'ātipātissa purisapuggalassa pāṇ'ātipātā veramaṇī hoti parinibbānāya.

69724.synonym: ārambhati, upahanti, khanati, tāpayati, dukkhāpeti, dussati, paritāpeti, bādheti, byāpajjati, byābādheti, hanati, hanti, hiṃsati
69724.commentary: (DNa) hiṃsatī'ti appamaṃsalohitaṃ karonto dukkhāpeti. vihiṃsatī'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ. (ANa) vihiṃsatī'ti viheṭheti. (ITIa) vihiṃsatī'ti bādhati āsādeti.

examples.text: sukhakāmāni bhūtāni, yo daṇḍena vihiṃsati, attano sukham'esāno, pecca so na labhate sukhaṃ.
tam'eva vācaṃ bhāseyya, yāy'attānaṃ na tāpaye, pare ca na vihiṃseyya, sā ve vācā subhāsitā.

69727.meaning1: perceiving as troublesome; thinking it burdensome

examples.text: apārutā tesaṃ amatassa dvārā, ye sotavanto pamuñcantu saddhaṃ, vihiṃsasaññī paguṇaṃ na bhāsiṃ, dhammaṃ paṇītaṃ manujesu brahme'ti.
paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsā-uparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya
apārutā tesaṃ amatassa dvārā, ye sotavanto pamuñcantu saddhaṃ, vihiṃsasaññī paguṇaṃ na bhāsiṃ, dhammaṃ paṇītaṃ manujesu brahme'ti.

69731.meaning1: interest in harming; desire for cruelty

examples.text: vihiṃsādhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati vihiṃsāsaññā, vihiṃsāsaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vihiṃsāsaṅkappo … vihiṃsāchando… vihiṃsāpariḷāho… vihiṃsāpariyesanā… vihiṃsāpariyesanaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyesamāno assutavā puthujjano tīhi ṭhānehi micchā paṭipajjati, kāyena, vācāya, manasā.

69732.meaning1: state of harming; state of cruelty
69732.commentary: (DNa) idh'ekacco pāṇinā vā leḍḍunā vā daṇḍena vā satthena vā rajjuyā vā aññatar'aññatarena vā satte viheṭhetī'ti ayaṃ vihiṃsādhātu. (SNa) vihiṃsādhātuṃ, bhikkhave'ti ettha vihiṃsāvitakko'pi vihiṃsādhātu vihiṃsā'pi.

examples.text: cha'y'imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, kāmadhātu, nekkhammadhātu, byāpādadhātu, abyāpādadhātu, vihiṃsādhātu, avihiṃsādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, cha dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

69733.meaning1: quest for harming; searching for cruelty

examples.text: vihiṃsādhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati vihiṃsāsaññā, vihiṃsāsaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vihiṃsāsaṅkappo … vihiṃsāchando… vihiṃsāpariḷāho… vihiṃsāpariyesanā… vihiṃsāpariyesanaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyesamāno assutavā puthujjano tīhi ṭhānehi micchā paṭipajjati, kāyena, vācāya, manasā.

69734.meaning1: fever for harming; burning passion for cruelty

examples.text: vihiṃsādhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati vihiṃsāsaññā, vihiṃsāsaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vihiṃsāsaṅkappo … vihiṃsāchando… vihiṃsāpariḷāho… vihiṃsāpariyesanā… vihiṃsāpariyesanaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyesamāno assutavā puthujjano tīhi ṭhānehi micchā paṭipajjati, kāyena, vācāya, manasā.

69735.meaning1: intention to harm; cruel intention; thought of violence

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, micchāsaṅkappo? kāmasaṅkappo, byāpādasaṅkappo, vihiṃsāsaṅkappo, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, micchāsaṅkappo.

69736.meaning1: perception connected with harm; recognition concerned with cruelty

examples.text: saññā'pi hi bahū anekavidhā nānappakārakā. kāmasaññā, byāpādasaññā, vihiṃsāsaññā, itosamuṭṭhānā akusalā saṅkappā.

69737.meaning1: thought of harming; idea of hurting; malign thought; thought of cruelty

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ n'ādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti

tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno majjhimasahagatā upakkilesā kāmavitakko byāpādavitakko vihiṃsāvitakko, tam'enaṃ sacetaso bhikkhu dabbajātiko pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.

69739.meaning2: having hurt, having injured, having annoyed

69740.commentary: (NIDD1a) vihiṃs'ūparatiyā'ti vihiṃsā nāma abhuttapaccayā uppajjanakakhuddā, tassā uparatiyā vūpasaman'atthāya āhāreti.

examples.text: paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya

69741.grammar: fem, comp, dat sg of vihiṃsūparati
69741.meaning1: for preventing harm; for stopping discomfort
69741.commentary: (VISM) vihiṃs'ūparatiyā'ti vihiṃsā nāma jighacchā ābādh'aṭṭhena. tassā uparam'attham'p'esa piṇḍapātaṃ paṭisevati, vaṇ'ālepanam'iva uṇhasīt'ādīsu tappaṭikāraṃ viya ca.

examples.text: n'eva davāya, na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya, vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya
buddho jan'ind'atthi manussaloke, kām'ābhibhū sakyamunī'ti ñāyati, tass'eva te puttā satiyā vihīnā, coditā mayā te satim'ajjhalatthuṃ.

69744.meaning1: in the habit of harming; accustomed to troubling (someone)

examples.text: idha, māṇava, ekacco itthī vā puriso vā sattānaṃ viheṭhakajātiko hoti, pāṇinā vā leḍḍunā vā daṇḍena vā satthena vā.
khantī paramaṃ tapo titikkhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā, na hi pabbajito par'ūpaghātī, na samaṇo hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto.

69749.commentary: (JAa) rājadhītari paṭibaddhacittatāya tassā vināsaṃ anicchanto mā ca kañci viheṭhayun'ti āha, tumhesu koci kañci mā viheṭhayā'ti attho. ayam'eva vā pāṭho.

examples.text: kambal'assatarā uṭṭhentu, sabbe nāge nivedaya, bārāṇasiṃ pavajjantu, mā ca kañci viheṭhayuṃ.
te ca manussā sakammapasutā rañño janapadaṃ na viheṭhiṃsu, mahā ca rañño rāsiko ahosi.

69753.meaning1: being annoyed; being troubled; being vexed (by)
69753.commentary: (VINa) kenaci viheṭhiyamāno'ti manussena vā tiracchānagatena vā viheṭhiyamāno. (KVt) anupasampanne'ti gahaṭṭhe vā pabbajite vā itthiyā vā purise vā antamaso tiracchānagatepi. sace pana rattacitto itthiṃ paharati, saṅgh'ādiseso. kenaci viheṭhiyamānassā'ti manussena vā tiracchānagatena vā viheṭhiyamānassa. mokkhādhippāyassā'ti tato attano mokkhaṃ patthayamānassa.

examples.text: anāpatti kenaci viheṭhīyamāno mokkh'ādhippāyo pahāraṃ deti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno, n'ev'āhaṃ āpanno'mhi, na pan'āhaṃ āpanno'mhī'ti so tuṇhībhāvena saṅghaṃ viheṭheti.
te bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ vā puccheyyuṃ vādaṃ vā āropeyyuṃ akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ viroseyyuṃ hiṃseyyuṃ vihiṃseyyuṃ heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ghāteyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ upaghātaṃ vā kareyyuṃ.

69755.meaning1: having harassed; having tormented; having tortured
69755.meaning2: having vexed, having brought into difficulties

examples.text: app'esakkhā ca appalābhā cā'ti bho pabbajjā nāma appayasā c'eva, pabbajitakālato paṭṭhāya hi rajjaṃ pahāya pabbajitaṃ viheṭhetvā viheṭhetvā lāmakaṃ anāthaṃ katvā'va kathenti. appalābhā ca, sakalagāmaṃ caritvā'pi ajjhoharaṇīyaṃ dullabham'eva.

manussā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma bhikkhuniyo antovassaṃ cārikaṃ carissanti haritāni tiṇāni ca sammaddantā, ek'indriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā, bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādentā'ti!

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, cattāro naṃ devaputtā catuddisaṃ rakkhāya upagacchanti, mā naṃ bodhisattaṃ vā bodhisattamātaraṃ vā manusso vā amanusso vā koci vā viheṭhesī'ti. ayam'ettha dhammatā.

69758.meaning1: vexing; annoying; irritating; troubling; (comm) annoying by keeping silent
69758.commentary: (VIN 2.5.2.2) vihesako nāma saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjīyamāno taṃ na kathetu'kāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetu'kāmo tuṇhībhūto saṅghaṃ viheseti. eso vihesako nāma. (VINa) vihesetī'ti vihesakaṃ, tuṇhībhūtass'etaṃ nāmaṃ

examples.text: aññavādake, vihesake pācittiyaṃ.
vihesako nāma saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjīyamāno taṃ na kathetu'kāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetu'kāmo tuṇhībhūto saṅghaṃ viheseti. eso vihesako nāma.

69759.meaning1: who is cruel; who harms; who annoys
69759.construction:
vi + hese + ā + vant
vihesā + vant

examples.text: yena kho, jīvaka, rāgena yena dosena yena mohena vihesavā assa arativā assa paṭighavā assa so rāgo so doso so moho tathāgatassa pahīno ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.

69760.notes: vihesā in poetry can be a shortened form of vihesāya (instr.sg)

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, kiṃ pan'imehi khudd'ānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāva'd'eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī'ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyaṃ.
satthena vā visena vā, vihesam'pi na kubbate, antarāmaraṇaṃ n'atthi, tesaṃ nissandato mama.

aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ karuṇāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya, atha ca pan'assa vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
karuṇaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. karuṇañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yā vihesā sā pahīyissati.

69762.meaning1: delight in harming; pleasure in cruelty

examples.text: tassa kāmanandīpi n'ānuseti, byāpādanandī'pi n'ānuseti, vihesānandī'pi n'ānuseti, rūpanandī'pi n'ānuseti, sakkāyanandī'pi n'ānuseti (so) kāmanandiyā'pi ananusayā, byāpādanandiyā'pi ananusayā, vihesānandiyā'pi ananusayā, rūpanandiyā'pi ananusayā, sakkāyanandiyā'pi ananusayā.

69763.meaning1: dependent on cruelty; due to harming

examples.text: tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ vihesāya. ye ca vihesāpaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. idam'akkhātaṃ vihesāya nissaraṇaṃ.

69764.meaning1: looking for trouble; wanting to annoy
69764.meaning2: looking for trouble; wanting to annoy

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci maṃ subhaddo pucchissati, sabbaṃ taṃ aññ'āpekkho'va pucchissati, no vihes'āpekkho. yaṃ c'ass'āhaṃ puṭṭho byākarissāmi, taṃ khippam'eva ājānissatī'ti.
n'āhaṃ taṃ, bhante nāgasena, vihesāpekkho pucchāmi, api ca nibbāhan'atthāya sandehassa pucchāmi, bahū manussā loke vāmagāmino vicakkhukā, kin'ti te otāraṃ na labheyyun'ti ev'āhaṃ taṃ pucchāmī'ti.

69765.meaning1: wanting to trouble; wishing to annoy; looking to irritate

examples.text: na kho mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ vihes'āpekhā pucchimha, api c'āyasmā khemako pahosi tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ.

69766.meaning1: accompanied by cruelty; full of viciousness

examples.text: idha, bhante, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti, abhijjhāsahagatena cetasā viharati, byāpādavā hoti, byāpādasahagatena cetasā viharati, vihesavā hoti, vihesāsahagatena cetasā viharati, evarūpaṃ, bhante, citt'uppādaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti.

69767.grammar: pr, pass of viheseti, caus, intrans (+instr)
69767.meaning2: is vexed; is annoyed; is irritated; is troubled (by)

69768.grammar: prp of vihesiyati, caus, pass, intrans (+instr)
69768.meaning1: being vexed; being harassed; being pestered (by)

examples.text: app'eva nāma tumhehi akkosiyamānānaṃ paribhāsiyamānānaṃ rosiyamānānaṃ vihesiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ, yathā taṃ dūsī māro labhetha otāran'ti.
atha kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā bhagavato sakkāraṃ asahamānā bhikkhusaṅghassa ca gāme ca araññe ca bhikkhū disvā asabbhāhi pharusāhi vācāhi akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti.
tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ pare akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti, so evaṃ pajānāti, uppannā kho me ayaṃ sotasamphassajā dukkhavedanā. sā ca kho paṭicca, no apaṭicca. kiṃ paṭicca?
paṇḍito, bhikkhave, pukkusāti kulaputto paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.
disvāna māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavoca, nikkhama, pāpima, nikkhama, pāpima! mā tathāgataṃ vihesesi, mā tathāgatasāvakaṃ. mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.

69771.meaning1: will live; will remain; will stay (in)
69771.meaning2: will live; will remain; will stay

examples.text: yo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, appamatto vihessati, pahāya jātisaṃsāraṃ, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatī'ti.

mahāsamudde'pi samantā yojanaṃ vīciyo vūpasantā, pañca vaṇṇāni padumāni pupphitāni, antalikkhe dibbāni tūriyāni pavajjiṃsu, ākāse jalaja-thalaja-rukkh'ādi-sannissitāhi devatāhi pavattitā ativiya uḷārā pūjā ahosi.

69776.grammar: prp of caus of √vīj, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato piṭṭhito ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ vījayamāno.
attha hi udakasoṇḍīsu udakakiccaṃ katvā sītāya rukkhacchāyāya nisinnassa nānādisāsu khāyamānāsu sītena vātena vījiyamānassa cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ hoti.

69781.meaning2: having fanned (abs of vījeti), having fanned

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, soṇa, kusalo tvaṃ pubbe agāriyabhūto vīṇāya tantissare'ti?

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rañño vā rājamah'āmattassa vā vīṇāya saddo assutapubbo assa. so vīṇāsaddaṃ suṇeyya. so evaṃ vadeyya, ambho, kassa nu kho eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti?

69792.meaningLit: discourse on the simile of lute

examples.text: accāraddhamhi vīriyamhi, satthā loke anuttaro, vīṇ'opamaṃ karitvā me, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā, tass'āhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, vihāsiṃ sāsane rato.

69794.grammar: pp of veti, in comps, neg

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittan'ti pajānāti, vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ cittan'ti pajānāti.
sabbesu kāmesu yo vītarāgo, ākiñcaññaṃ nissito hitvā m'aññaṃ, saññāvimokkhe parame'dhimutto, tiṭṭheyya so tattha anānuyāyī.

69795.commentary: (VINa) suvītan'ti suṭṭhu vītaṃ, sabbaṭṭhānesu samaṃ katvā vītaṃ.

examples.text: idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ'ca karotha, vitthatañ'ca, appitañ'ca, suvītañ'ca, suppavāyitañ'ca, suvilekhitañ'ca, suvitacchitañ'ca karotha
sabbaso nāmarūpasmiṃ, vītagedhassa brāhmaṇa, āsavā'ssa na vijjanti, yehi maccuvasaṃ vaje'ti.
vītagedho amaccharī, na ussesu vadate muni, na samesu na omesu, kappaṃ n'eti akappiyo.

69797.meaning1: without burning charcoal; i.e. without lighting fires

examples.text: tam'enaṃ manussā disvā evam'āhaṃsu, ime kho, bho, sattā araññ'āyatane paṇṇakuṭiyo karitvā paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti, vīt'aṅgārā vītadhūmā pannamusalā sāyaṃ sāyam'āsāya pāto pātarāsāya gāmanigamarājadhāniyo osaranti ghāsam'esamānā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā puṇṇā aṅgārānaṃ vīt'accikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ
vāmahatthena gopphake gahetvā dakkhiṇahatthena khuraṃ gahetvā pādatalāni phāletvā loṇatelena makkhetvā khadir'aṅgārehi vīt'accitehi paciṃsu.
